purpose: Concise typed food matching and review with safe cloud save retries.
adaptations: Manual line parsing, exact food matching, quantity conversions and text provenance use the existing imported source domain owners.
The PWA uses a compact input and row review, optional date/time disclosure, editable amounts and an explicit Add to diary action.
Default group is Uncategorized when configured; an explicit diary group shortcut takes precedence.
An uncertain save retains an immutable revision, request ID and payload. Edits stay locked until the same save is retried; a stale revision instead requires matching again.
Closing clears unsaved text and rows. Child Back or Escape returns to review without committing child edits.
Browser speech input only produces text. Matching and logging require separate actions; no new model, native bridge or speech service was introduced.

verification.local: tests/text-log-ui.test.mjs covers typed matching, quantities, exact save retry, stale revision, groups, disposal and simulated dictation.
verification.hosted: scripts/verify-text-log-hosted.mjs is prepared and syntax checked; run after deployment with a disposable account. It uses actual Diary Add and group shortcuts, styled review, lost response and stale revision checks.

limits: Saved Cronometer voice captures cover startup permission and denial only. A successful native voice or text results screen was not captured.
This is a concise adaptation of the source review workflow, not a claim of pixel parity with an unseen native screen.
Hosted verification uses typed input only and does not establish real speech recognition or microphone permission behavior.
